about: Sainte-Marthe-sur-le-Lac is a city on the north shore of the Lac des Deux Montagnes in the Laurentians foothills west of Montreal, Quebec. Lakeside neighbourhoods, a marina character, and suburban growth along Highway 640 define a waterfront community in the Deux-Montagnes RCM. About 20,000 people live in Sainte-Marthe-sur-le-Lac.
seoSummary: North-shore lake city west of Montreal on Lac des Deux Montagnes—marina neighbourhoods and Highway 640 suburb.
